stationScope.evidence: Stadtwerke Weinheim's official current tariff page publishes a distinct Ad-hoc Ladung tariff for its charging network: 0.59 EUR/kWh AC with 0.07 EUR/min after 180 minutes and 0.69 EUR/kWh DC with 0.07 EUR/min after 120 minutes. The time fee is capped at 15 EUR per charging session. The official mobility page confirms ad-hoc use without registration through the Direct Payment QR code or NFC at the station. DE*674 EVSEs are observed under Stadtwerke Weinheim in the national/station data.

note: The official 15 EUR maximum time-fee cap is documented but intentionally not encoded because the current direct-offer pricing schema has no validated cap field; adding one would be a broader policy/schema change. Roaming and registered e-laden tariffs remain separate and are not propagated to third-party CPOs.
